name: _root_.aestronglyMeasurable_iff_nullMeasurable_separable
statement: AEStronglyMeasurable f μ ↔ NullMeasurable f μ ∧ ∃ t : Set β, IsSeparable t ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ t

name: _root_.Topology.IsEmbedding.aestronglyMeasurable_comp_iff
statement: β → γ} {f : α → β} (hg : IsEmbedding g) : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => g (f x)) μ ↔ AEStronglyMeasurable f μ

name: _root_.exists_stronglyMeasurable_limit_of_tendsto_ae
statement: ℕ → α → β} (hf : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) μ) (h_ae_tendsto : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ l : β, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) atTop (𝓝 l)) : ∃ f_lim : α → β, StronglyMeasurable f_lim ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) atTop (𝓝 (f_lim x))
